name: Access Sunset Date Reminder
description: Sent to a user to remind them that their access to an item is coming to an end.
subject: Reminder: Your Access End Date Is Approaching
body:
Access End Date Reminder

Dear ${recipientName},

Your access is scheduled to end soon. Please review the details below.

Access item: ${accessItemName}

Access type: ${accessItemType}

End date: ${scheduledSunsetDate}

If you still need access to ${accessItemName}, extend it by updating the access expiration date.

If you have questions, contact the ${PRODUCT_NAME} administrator.

Thank you for using ${PRODUCT_NAME}.
